methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the jQuery object to a true array.

methods.description: Retrieves the DOM elements matched by the jQuery object.

methods.description: Creates a new jQuery object from an array of elements, maintaining chainability.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Iterates over the matched elements, executing a callback.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms each element in the set via a callback.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a subset of the matched elements.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Gets the first element in the set.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Gets the last element in the set.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Gets the element at a specific index.
